note: Account events (build section 2, blueprint 22 and 41). These are written by the cloud only, never by a device, on the person's own '_identity' stream. Payloads carry references (public ids, scopes, site names), never phone numbers, emails, codes or secrets. The merchant-core contract in contract/ stays the authority for device events; this register is the authority for account events, and every 'event:' trigger in catalog/automations.v1.json must name an event from one of the two. Two shell events of build section 1 (CountryPackSelected, ConnectionWeak) are listed here too: they are local device triggers for the shell's own automations.

AccountCreated.note: sign-up finished: username taken, contact verified, recovery code confirmed

UsernameChanged.note: the old username redirects; it is never reissued to anyone else

SessionStarted.note: triggers the sign-in alert automation when new_device or new_place is true

SessionRevoked.note: by = self, security_center, recovery or staff

RecoveryStarted.note: path = device, code or assisted; triggers the recovery guide

SecurityAlertSent.note: kind = new_sign_in, recovery_started, recovery_done, payout_change, data_request; the message never carries a link

ConsentGranted.note: every data-sharing consent (health pack, accountant, lender, developer app, support)

ConsentExpiring.note: written by the consent-expiry automation seven days before the end

PayoutChangeRequested.note: takeover safeguard: a waiting period before payout or bank details change unless a second enrolled device approves

DataRequestOpened.note: download my records; the data-request timer automation watches due_at

AccountCloseRequested.note: a grace period; the LynkID is retired at the end and never reused

StandingPaymentApproved.note: N4: the customer's own capped standing instruction, held by the licensed provider and told every time it is used

RegistrationStarted.note: N14 Start a business; the same names as the merchant-core contract, on the person's stream

GuideOffered.note: LynkAssist guide (inform): recovery or start-a-business steps, labelled as a suggestion

DataRequestReminder.note: data-request timer automation: the request is due soon or overdue

CheckInDrafted.note: quiet-business watch (draft): a support check-in a person confirms before it is sent

RenewalReminderSent.note: renewal reminder (inform), seven days before a paid plan renews

AutomationRan.note: every LynkFlow run, with 'Why did this happen?'

CountryPackSelected.note: shell event (build section 1, left out of every register until section 2): the person chose a country pack; smart defaults follow. Written by the device for itself, never sent as a merchant-core event

ConnectionWeak.note: shell event (build section 1): the connection became weak or offline; the data-saver plan follows. Local to the device

IdentityCheckRequested.note: BIZZ & DEVICE: the person asked the licensed payment partner to check who they are (before a first paid Storefront offer); shown as sent until the partner answers

IdentityCheckConfirmed.note: The licensed partner confirmed the person's identity; written by the cloud from the partner's answer only, never by a device

LocationShareStarted.note: Arrive Safe: the person started sharing with someone they chose, under a location-share consent with an end time (contract v4 event)

LocationShareEnded.note: Arrive Safe: a share was stopped, expired or its trip ended; nothing more is shared

TripPlanSet.note: Arrive Safe: a trip plan with a check-in deadline and the number of trusted contacts (never who or where)

TripPlanCheckedIn.note: Arrive Safe: the traveller checked in on time

TripPlanOverdue.note: Arrive Safe: cloud only; the deadline passed with no check-in and the trusted contacts are told

ProvisionalAccountStarted.note: MASTER UPDATE 55: an account started on one device with no network; no contact or username in the payload

ProvisionalAccountConfirmed.note: the cloud confirmed the contact and username, or the records joined an existing account after verification

OfflinePermissionGranted.note: face-to-face approval after the numbers matched; at most 3 days, never owner, restricted until confirmed

OfflinePermissionConfirmed.note: cloud only: the approving device was still trusted, so the restriction ends

DeviceHardLocked.note: too many wrong PINs; nothing is destroyed

DeviceUnlocked.note: unlocked by the recovery code, another signed-in device or online recovery

DeviceCopySuspended.note: cloud only: one identity on two devices; both wait for the owner

OfflineLimitReached.note: past the role's offline limit the device sells for cash only until it reconnects
